parsed.explanation: No trans-specific evidence is documented—no presentation offence, border, facilities, custody or care practice is sourced—so this is a thin-data extrapolation, not a midpoint. Structurally, same-sex conduct is regularly prosecuted in government areas (3 months–3 years, plus surveillance), with death-penalty imposition at judicial discretion in insurgent/southern areas and documented armed-group killings, most recently in 2024. Severe taboo/stigma, no anti-discrimination protection, pervasive conflict and general impunity leave no recourse if a visibly trans visitor is outed and treated as gender/sexual nonconformity. That aligns hostile law and society, making consequences severe, though near-certain trans-specific targeting, as at 0.15, is not documented.
